1903 is not a leap year (1900 is not a leap year under Gregorian rules).  
03-23-1903 minus 163 days:  
March has 31 days, so back to start of March: 23 days back → March 1.  
That used 23 days, 140 days left.  
February 1903 has 28 days, January has 31 days, December 1902 has 31 days, November 1902 has 30 days, October 1902 has 31 days.  
140 days: go back 28 days (Feb) → Jan 1 (31 days) → Dec 1 (31 days) → Nov 1 (30 days) → Oct 2 (31 days).  
Check: 28+31+31+30+20 = 140 days back from March 1 → October 2, 1902.  

FINAL_ANSWER: 1902-10-02
